Known as Zama Zamas, around 34,000 illegal miners are thought to be working in South Africa, in the hope of finding gold and chromium. The mines they dig hollow out the ground, which causes buildings to collapse as well as frequent power outages.

summary: #Tehran says at least four people were killed and dozens more wounded in a #US strike on a town near in the south of #Iran, near the Strait of #Hormuz.

title: ICE says it now has enough body cameras. And, Congress averts shutdown before midterms
summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says it now has enough body cameras to equip all of its agents. And, Congress votes to fund the government, averting a government shutdown ahead of the midterms.

title: What's true and false about infertility? We asked a fertility specialist.
summary: Dr. Temeka Zore, a double board-certified OB-GYN and fertility specialist, joined "Healthful" for a deep dive on all things fertility, from endometriosis to PMOS (formerly known as PCOS) to egg freezing.

title: Military buildup seen in Ethiopia near Sudanese border
summary: A major military buildup has been observed on the Ethiopian side of the Sudanese border. It comes amid intensified fighting between the Sudanese armed forces and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Sudan and Ethiopia have both accused each other of supporting rebels within their borders.

title: "C'est dur" : au Sénégal, le ras-le-bol des ménages face à la vie chère
summary: Au Sénégal, la hausse des prix alimente la colère des ménages. Une campagne citoyenne réclame des mesures contre la vie chère, alors que Dakar a conclu mardi un accord de principe avec le FMI pour un programme d'aide de 2,2 milliards de dollars sur la période 2026-2029.

title: What we know about alleged US strike on Iran wedding
summary: US forces launched fresh attacks on Iran Tuesday, including one that the Iranian Red Crescent said left four people dead at a wedding celebration, with Tehran vowing "severe punishment" for the strikes. France 24's correspondent in Tehran Reza Sayeh has the latest.

title: ‘Tower of broken dreams’: French artist takes Eiffel Tower work to Burning man
summary: A French artist from Saint-Malo-du-Bois in the Vendée region has taken a sculpture known as the “Broken Eiffel Tower” all the way to the United States. The 26-metric-ton structure was dismantled piece by piece to be shipped from the port of Le Havre before being reconstructed at the Burning Man festival in the Nevada desert. Caitlin Brown reports

title: Frappes américaines contre l'Iran : Téhéran mène une vaste riposte dans la région
summary: L'Iran a mené mercredi une riposte d'envergure au Moyen-Orient après une nouvelle salve de frappes sur son sol, qui ont notamment endeuillé un mariage dans le sud du pays selon Téhéran.

title: Venezuela : le jackpot pétrolier de Donald Trump
summary: Le secrétaire américain à l’Énergie, Chris Wright, est à Caracas pour concrétiser un accord pétrolier hors norme. Pendant cent ans, une entreprise soutenue par Washington pourra exploiter 17 champs contenant près d’un cinquième des réserves vénézuéliennes.

summary: L'exposition au British Museum de la tapisserie de Bayeux, qu'Emmanuel Macron visitera en avant-première mercredi, s'annonce comme l'événement de tous les superlatifs pour le musée londonien.

summary: À la Une de la presse, mercredi : la rentrée en Ukraine, dans des écoles souterraines ; le Forum des Îles du Pacifique, sous tension géopolitique ; et la tapisserie de Bayeux inaugurée au British Museum de Londres, une histoire de diplomatie mais pas que.

title: Nepal floods: Families gather at overwhelmed morgues in desperate search for loved ones
summary: In Nepal, the hope of finding survivors is fading daily. Bodies are piling up in morgues, and storage capacity is reaching its limit. Authorities are beginning to bury the remains after DNA samples are taken and an identification number is assigned. The hope is that families will be able to find them later. For the relatives of the missing, the wait is unbe…

title: "J'aimerais entendre sa voix une dernière fois" : au Népal, la détresse des familles de disparus
summary: Une semaine après la crue dévastatrice qui a frappé le Népal, à la frontière avec la Chine, plus de 4 500 personnes restent portées disparues mercredi. À Katmandou, les familles parcourent hôpitaux et morgues dans l'espoir d'identifier un proche, alors que les chances de retrouver des survivants s'amenuisent.

title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
summary: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1.

title: He died of 'natural causes.' But his mother says she knows what killed him: heat
summary: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

title: Germany blames Russia for last month's attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
summary: The German government blamed Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig airport last month using a drone laden with explosives. It announced that it would shut down a Russian consulate among measures.

title: Hong Kong : l'une des figures prodémocratie, Joshua Wong, plaide coupable de collusion
summary: Lors de son procès pour atteinte à la sécurité nationale, Joshua Wong, 29 ans, figure du mouvement prodémocratie à Hong Kong, a plaidé coupable mercredi de collusion avec l'étranger. Il purge déjà une peine de près de cinq ans d'emprisonnement pour subversion et risque désormais la prison à vie.

title: Emmanuel Macron attendu à Londres pour dévoiler la tapisserie de Bayeux et rencontrer Andy Burnham
summary: Le président français est attendu, mercredi, à Londres pour dévoiler la tapisserie de Bayeux, prêtée au British Museum et exposée du 10 septembre au 11 juillet 2027. Emmanuel Macron doit également rencontrer le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham avant un entretien jeudi à Downing Street.

title: U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation
summary: The U.S. military hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones at various sites across the region in response as hostilities flare once again in an intermittent war.

title: US Postal Service whistleblower warns new system could disrupt midterm election voting
summary: A US Postal Service whistleblower has warned that a new ballot-processing system ordered by President Donald Trump and due to launch Tuesday could prevent millions of Americans from receiving mail ballots ahead of November's midterm elections.

title: Après neuf mois en mer, le porte-avions américain Lincoln fait escale à Pattaya en Thaïlande
summary: Le porte-avions américain Abraham-Lincoln est arrivé, mercredi, à Pattaya, en Thaïlande pour y faire escale après près de trois cents jours passés en mer. Il doit rester à quai jusqu'à dimanche. Le navire de guerre est par ailleurs au cœur d'une polémique sur les conditions de vie à son bord.

title: Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
summary: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong on Wednesday pleaded guilty to colluding with foreign powers in a trial that could see the 29-year-old spend the rest of his life behind bars. Wong rose to international prominence for his involvement in the 2014 Umbrella Movement and the mass protests against Beijing that rocked the financial hub in 2019.

title: Defense attorney believes jury had "preconceived notions" in Tupac trial
summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted of first-degree murder nearly 30 years after the drive-by shooting that killed Tupac Shakur.

summary: Un juge de l'Utah a ordonné mardi le renvoi en procès de Tyler Robinson, 23 ans, accusé du meurtre du militant ultra conservateur Charlie Kirk en septembre 2025. Le suspect, qui risque la peine de mort, a plaidé non coupable.

summary: Un tribunal hondureño retiró los cargos de fraude y lavado contra el expresidente Juan Orlando Hernández, quien ya había sido indultado en EE. UU. por Donald Trump tras una condena de 45 años por narcotráfico. Tras conocer la resolución, Hernández se dirigió a sus simpatizantes y reiteró que todo fue producto de una persecución política.

title: El Parlamento de Nicaragua aprueba en lo general una reforma que veta a la oposición de las elecciones
summary: El Parlamento de Nicaragua aprobó, en primera instancia, el martes 1 de septiembre una reforma constitucional que prohíbe a los partidos de oposición participar en las elecciones y amplía el mandato presidencial de seis a siete años. El plan, impulsado por el presidente Daniel Ortega, ha sido condenada por Estados Unidos y otros países de la región.

title: Midterms 2026 : le vote par correspondance est en danger, avertit un lanceur d'alerte
summary: À deux mois des élections de mi-mandat aux États-Unis, un lanceur d'alerte affirme mardi que la Poste américaine a développé "en secret" des systèmes informatiques de manière "bâclée et précipitée" pour se conformer à un décret de Donald Trump visant à encadrer plus sévèrement le vote par correspondance. title: Middle East live: Iran launches retaliatory strikes after fresh US bombing kills 11 people
summary: Iranian state media reported Wednesday that US strikes killed 11 people in two separate attacks, including four at a wedding in the country’s south. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said they have responded by attacking US assets in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan and Erbil in Iraqi Kurdistan. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

title: Macron in Britain to help unveil Bayeux tapestry for historic exhibition
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will be the first EU leader to meet new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham during a two-day visit to the UK that began Wednesday. Macron will first inaugurate a historic exhibition of the 950-year-old Bayeux Tapestry, on loan to the British Museum in London.
